    # Actually, let me simplify:

    F_mag = 24 * epsilon * (2 * (sigma / r_mag)**12 - (sigma / r_mag)**6) / r_mag
    
    # Force direction is along the displacement vector
    F_vec = F_mag * (r / r_mag)
    
    return F_vec
